The general practitioner, as in the joke, is always busy, and appointments are only available in 2-3 weeks, and even then only by telephone. You will wait forever for a telephone appointment with the doctor. Even if you are lucky enough to get through to them in the morning, it does not mean that they will call you back later, as they promise. Recently, their attitude towards patients has deteriorated significantly. I hear from my friends how they make appointments with their doctor. It's like something out of a fantasy novel. They can get a consultation on the same day, and they will be scheduled for tests and given referrals to other doctors. They promise to call back and don't call back. I called several times and went to their reception desk to ask about the possibility of booking an appointment with a doctor, but they only make promises and do nothing. They received a letter from our surgeon, but they only replied to it six months later. How do you feel about this attitude?
I will have to find a new gp, even though we live nearby.But I will also complain about them.
